description: Embedded media player window: the window chrome it drives (title, fullscreen, close), listening for events, and Prism's player_* commands, each granted by name. mpv itself is reached only through those allowlisting commands (src-tauri/src/player.rs); the libmpv plugin's raw command/set_property/init passthrough is deliberately NOT granted. No core:default: its event permissions would let this window emit quick-add-url or watch-folder-links, which the main window treats as in-app (REVIEW 2026-09-23 S-2).
